author: ojiudezue
title: Bermuda's per-scanner distance sensors died on 10-20 because the wall-panel proxies have no matching Wi-Fi MAC
summary: Bermuda 0.8.7 create_scanner_entities() returns early for every device if any remote scanner lacks address_wifi_mac. The 7 kiosk_satellite panel proxies (registered 10-19/20) advertise Bluetooth addresses unrelated to their randomised Android MACs, so the -3..+2 offset match fails. Last statistics hour 07:00 UTC, 28 min after the Kitchen panel registered.
why: One mechanism explains every observation: all four people, all 356 sensors, the exact date, and the per-device sensors staying live (created on a different code path). Removing the cause would cost the panel scanners the operator wanted, so the URA-side answer is to stop depending on per-scanner sensors.
implications: Recommended: URA re-bases person distance on the live per-phone Bermuda sensor, resolved through the registry, and an upstream Bermuda issue. Re-basing turns on the music 8 ft gate for the first time, so that is a separate operator yes/no.

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: local patch lost on the next update and needs a restart

alternatives_considered.option: Drop the panel proxies as scanners
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: loses the room coverage the operator wanted

revisit_trigger: If a Bermuda release changes create_scanner_entities, re-check whether the per-scanner sensors come back.
